_note: ESMS scripted pass (HANDOFF item 5, 2026-09-05): Eurostat's HICP national reference metadata (prc_hicp_esms{hi3,hi4}_<cc>.htm, section 18.1.1 'Weights') read for all 32 countries that publish one; sentences stating the weight source quoted verbatim. This slice holds only the edges that did not already exist; existing B/C edges were re-cited or quoted in place in their own slices (eu-national-chains-2026-08-28.json mostly). Sweden's page says the HBS 'is therefore not used as a source for the HICP weights' — no SE HBS edge, deliberately. Countries with an ESMS page but no HICP node in the corpus (CZ DE-HICP DK FR IT NL NO RO-HICP CH AL TR) are leads, recorded in _dropped.

dependencies.basis: RESEARCHED 2026-09-05 (ESMS scripted pass). Eurostat's national reference metadata for the BE HICP (prc_hicp_esmshi4_be.htm, section 18.1.1 weights) states the HICP weights are derived from national accounts household final consumption expenditure. Read live (200), quote verbatim from the page.
dependencies.evidence_quote: As of 2010, the major source for the HICP weights are the national accounts. National accounts are used up to ECOICOP level 5 since the introduction of ESA 2010.

dependencies.basis: RESEARCHED 2026-09-05 (ESMS scripted pass). Eurostat's national reference metadata for the HR HICP (prc_hicp_esmshi4_hr.htm, section 18.1.1 weights) states the HICP weights are derived from the household budget survey. Read live (200), quote verbatim from the page.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Below the 5-digit level, weights are based mostly on the last available HBS data.

dependencies.basis: RESEARCHED 2026-09-05 (ESMS scripted pass). Eurostat's national reference metadata for the LT HICP (prc_hicp_esmshi4_lt.htm, section 18.1.1 weights) states the HICP weights are derived from the household budget survey. Read live (200), quote verbatim from the page.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Below the ECOICOP ver.2 level, expenditure is distributed to representative products using the household expenditure structure from the Household Budget Survey (HBS), most recently conducted in 2019.
